finding_json.title: SQL injection: untrusted input reaches 'sql_execute_var' sink
finding_json.description: Deterministic detector: a SQL sink ('sql_execute_var') co-occurs with a query built from untrusted input in `app/services/db.py`. Evidence line 11: cur.execute(sql)
attack_chain: Attacker supplies a crafted value via the HTTP request parameter named at this finding's taint source location.
The value is string-formatted (.format()/%/f-string/concatenation) into a SQL statement with no parameterisation.
The statement reaches the 'sql_execute_var' sink at app/services/db.py:11 and executes against the database.
finding_json.remediation: Use parameterised queries / bound parameters everywhere (cursor.execute(sql, params); pandas.read_sql(sql, con, params=...)). Never build SQL with .format()/%/f-strings/concatenation on request data.

taint.proof_basis: Tier-1 taint proven (CWE-89): caller-tainted parameter ``sql`` → cur.execute; path across 3 files: app/main.py:12 → app/services/search.py:4 → app/services/db.py:8 → app/services/db.py:11; sanitizer missing

evidence.detail: AST confirms a CWE-89 sink-family call near line 11

poc.invocation: Send via the HTTP parameter that reaches this sink (see the taint source location on this finding).
poc.expected_effect: Query returns all rows or raises a SQL error -> injection confirmed.

verification.rationale: 3/5 independent signals passed (need 1): grounded, taint_complete, concrete_poc.
